x: Beesley turned out for us in the 440, but he was in Terry Higgins' heat and just failed to qualify for the final. Jim Heathfield also competed, but our quarter men are not yet up to this standard of competition.
Ian Badiali won the 440 yds. in the good time of 51.5 secs., and Jack Brown was second to Terry Higgins in the 880 in 1 min. 57 secs., with Alan Bishop in third place

Arthur Wint continued to dominate the scene in the 400m although Les Lewis, Alan Dick and Terry Higgins were beginning to show prominently. Our 800 metre competition was still commanded by Arthur Wint unless challenged by Roger Bannister and the two other performers Frank Evans and Albert Webster.
